13c3ac832e.t:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

UX Writing is a core design discipline at Airbnb. Our team of 40+ writers works closely with Experience Design, Experience Research, and Design Program Management to support the product development process from beginning to end. Whether you excel in upfront storytelling, end-to-end systems design, or nitty-gritty execution you'll find your people here.

The Difference You Will Make

The International team makes Airbnb’s products more local. You’ll deploy a deep and nuanced understanding of regional needs, cultural and linguistic norms, and regulatory environments to craft language and interfaces that resonate with local audiences.

Working alongside the London-based team, you’ll support the design of country-specific features for key markets including Italy, Germany, Spain, France and the UK.

You will collaborate with cross-regional partners such as country managers, localization experts, linguists and translators, researchers, product specialists, engineers, and data scientists to craft meaningful and inclusive products that empower guests and hosts around the world.

This role is based in London (or within easy commuting distance).

A Typical Day

· Write clear and concise copy across multiple product touch-points

· Define and drive the UX Writing function within Global Markets, establishing workflows, partnerships, and standards for a newly forming team, including reviewing and mentoring other UX writers

· Drive strategy and UX Writing deliverables across multiple highly complex projects

· Develop inspiring, strategic ideas based on product requirements, data, and/or research

· Consider what language and design patterns best serve the UX

· Present content and design work to Design Directors, executives, or other stakeholders on your projects

· Drive consensus with stakeholders and/or partners on content recommendations

· Manage copy deadlines and deliver detailed copy across multiple projects

· Connect with our critical cross-functional partners—accessibility, anti-discrimination, legal, localization, country managers—to ensure we have the proper input on our work

· Partner closely with the central UX Writing team to ensure Global Markets work is aligned with shared standards, voice, and quality bar

Your Expertise

· 12+ years of experience in UX writing, content design, or content strategy

· Background within global consumer tech companies or marketplaces preferred

· Proven ability to lead content/copy work from concept to detailed design

· Experience working with localization platforms and/or translation services

· Experience working with and presenting to executive teams

· Experience writing content principles, messaging frameworks, and style guides

· Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams in all stages design & build

· Solid understanding of user experience design principles and interaction patterns

· Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment

· Proven ability to move work forward in an ambiguous work environment

· Comfortable working alongside other design disciplines in Figma , our primary collaboration tool

· Passion for Airbnb’s mission, commitment to diversity, and global mindset

· Bilingual in German, Spanish, French, or Italian is welcome (but not required)

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

13c3ac832e.h: How We'll Take Care of You
13c3ac832e.t: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

1b2feb5c8a.t:
The Workouts Design Team at Peloton is focused on designing new software experiences that enable people to live both healthier and longer lives. The team works collaboratively with designers across the organization to create new workout experiences, novel software interactions for new hardware products, and intuitive ways of getting the best workout at-home, outdoors, or even in the gym.

Our Content Designers work strategically and cross-functionally to help craft flows for our members with intentional content that informs and helps our users make decisions to get maximum benefit from our fitness experiences. They approach problems with an agile mentality and rapidly iterate alongside cross-functional partners.

As a Senior Content Designer, you’ll partner closely with product designers, product managers, user researchers, engineers, product marketing, brand creative, and other cross-functional teams to bring features to life across our platforms.

Successful candidates are self-motivated, strategic, highly collaborative, proactive project owners, readily open to feedback and critique. They value the success of the team over their individual progress, and are often taking leadership over delivering outcomes.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, UXR/Analytics, and engineering to understand user needs and product goals

· Lead the creation and development of content strategies that influence the overall user experience

· Craft member-centric content for a variety of touchpoints across member journeys including UI, notifications, help documentation, etc.

· Partner with Brand and Product Marketing teams to develop and maintain a consistent tone of voice across our products

· Conduct content audits to ensure accuracy, relevance, quality, and adherence to the style guide

· Organize and maintain docs, decks and design files that can easily be tracked by cross-functional teams and partners

· Work closely with other Content Designers to develop and maintain content style guide, drive and advocate for best practices, and stay in the know of industry trends that could improve content strategies

· Help write content standards and contribute to our style guide

· Partner with legal, localization and support teams to ensure the content is accurately and responsibly launched

· 6+ years experience as a Content Designer or similar role (e.g. UX Writer, Content Strategist) in a software product environment

· You have a portfolio that showcases your craft and demonstrates how you think and solve problems

· A deep understanding of user experience and how content, design, research and more come together to build frictionless user flows

· Skills to set up frameworks and brainstorm initial design concepts

· The ability to present ideas, bring strategies to life, and incorporate feedback into your iterative work

· Experience working with AI, including dynamic and non-deterministic interfaces

· Comfortable working with ambiguous requirements and ability to quickly adapt and flex on direction of projects

· Excellent communication and organizational skills

· Cognitive awareness of wider business goals, delivering intuitive and user-centered design solutions

· Familiarity with the design systems, interaction patterns, and limitations of cross functional platforms - specifically Android, iOS, and web apps.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position based at our New York City headquarters. The actual base salary offered for this position will depend on numerous factors including, without limitation, experience and business objectives and if the location for the job changes.

Our base salary is just one component of Peloton’s competitive total rewards strategy that also includes annual equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan as well as other region-specific health and welfare benefits.

As an organization, one of our top priorities is to maintain the health and wellbeing for our employees and their family. To achieve this goal, we offer robust and comprehensive benefits including:

· Medical, dental and vision insurance

· Generous paid time off policy

· Short-term and long-term disability

· Access to mental health services

· 401k, tuition reimbursement and student loan paydown plans

· Employee Stock Purchase Plan

· Fertility and adoption support and up to 18 weeks of paid parental leave

· Child care and family care discounts

· Free access to Peloton Digital App and apparel and product discounts

· Commuter benefits and Citi Bike Discount

· Pet insurance and so much more!

Peloton (NASDAQ: PTON) provides Members with expert instruction, and world class content to create impactful and entertaining workout experiences for anyone, anywhere and at any stage in their fitness journey. At home, outdoors, traveling, or at the gym, Peloton brings together innovative hardware, distinctive software, and exclusive content.

Founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City, Peloton has millions of Members across the US, UK, Canada, Germany, Australia, and Austria. For more information, visit www.onepeloton.com.

Peloton is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.

Equal employment opportunity has been, and will continue to be, a fundamental principle at Peloton, where all team members, applicants, and other covered persons are considered on the basis of their personal capabilities and qualifications without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic predisposition or carrier status, unemployment status, familial status, domestic violence, sexual violence or stalking victim status, caregiver status, or any other protected characteristic as established by applicable law.

This policy of equal employment opportunity applies to all practices and procedures relating to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, termination, and all other terms and conditions of employment. If you would like to request any accommodations from application through to interview, please email: applicantaccommodations@onepeloton.com .

At Peloton, we embrace technology, including AI, to enhance productivity and accelerate innovation in the work we do for our members. However, in our hiring process, our priority remains in getting to know you and your unique qualifications.

To ensure a fair and equitable process, we do not permit the use of AI tools during any stage of the application and interview process. In considering you as an applicant, we want to understand your skills, experiences, and motivations without mediation through an AI system.

We also want to directly assess your communication skills without the use of an AI tool.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, as applicable to applicants applying for positions in these jurisdictions.

Du siehst sofort, wenn ein Layout nicht funktioniert? Du hast Lust, eine Marke nicht nur zu pflegen, sondern sichtbar besser zu machen? Und du willst dich gestalterisch weiterentwickeln, statt nur abzuarbeiten?
Dann passt du wahrscheinlich richtig gut zu uns.
Wir bauen unser Marketing gerade neu auf und heben es auf ein professionelles Niveau. Genau dafür suchen wir dich: einen kreativen Kopf, der gestalterisch denkt und Lust hat, gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufzubauen. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Team eng mit einer Kollegin und mir zusammen, mit kurzen Wegen, direktem Austausch und viel Raum für eigene Ideen.
Die GLOBAL-FINANZ ist einer der führenden Finanzdienstleister in Deutschland mit Sitz in Bonn. Für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden entwickeln wir Lösungen rund um Vermögensaufbau, Altersvorsorge und Immobilieninvestments.
Aufgaben
Dein Kern ist das Gestalten. Du machst aus unseren Materialien etwas, das nicht nach Standard aussieht, sondern professionell, modern und markengerecht ist. Dazu gehört zum Beispiel:
Layouts, Vorlagen und Designs für Broschüren, Flyer, One-Pager und Präsentationen
die Weiterentwicklung unseres Markenauftritts und unserer CI, von Farben über Typografie bis zu einem einheitlichen Icon- und Bildstil
Du wirst dabei nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen. Themen wie Farbmanagement musst du nicht von Tag eins beherrschen. Wichtig ist, dass du Lust hast, dich da reinzuarbeiten und richtig gut darin zu werden.
Auch Fotografie gehört zur Rolle. Equipment ist vorhanden, du brauchst vor allem ein gutes Auge: für Berater-Porträts, Veranstaltungen oder Bilder von unserer Zentrale, die professionell wirken.
Und wir wollen sichtbarer werden. Social Media, vor allem Instagram und TikTok, wird Schritt für Schritt ein fester Teil deiner Rolle. Das heißt: Content mitdenken, Videos drehen und schneiden. Wenn dir das Spaß macht, bist du hier genau richtig.
Qualifikation
ein starkes Gespür für Design, Ästhetik, Bildsprache und Markenwirkung
gute Kenntnisse in Tools wie InDesign, Photoshop und PowerPoint
ein gutes Auge für Details, Typografie und visuelle Qualität
Lust, Dinge nicht nur schön, sondern auch durchdacht umzusetzen
Offenheit für Fotografie, Video, Schnitt und Social-Media-Content
eine positive, neugierige Art und echte Lust, dich weiterzuentwickeln
Freude daran, in einem kleinen Team eng zusammenzuarbeiten
Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist für uns zweitrangig. Wichtiger sind dein Können, dein Gespür und deine Arbeitsweise. Ob du dir deine Skills über eine Ausbildung, Berufserfahrung, freie Projekte oder privat aufgebaut hast, ist uns egal. Zeig uns einfach, was du kannst und worauf du stolz bist.
Warum die Rolle spannend ist
Du kommst nicht in eine fertige Abteilung, sondern in ein Umfeld, das gerade entsteht. Bisher haben wir vieles selbst gestaltet oder extern gelöst. Was uns fehlt, ist genau dein Blick: der eines Menschen, der Gestaltung wirklich kann und unseren Auftritt auf ein neues Level hebt. Du prägst, wie unsere Marke aussieht und wirkt, und hast dabei viel Verantwortung, viel Freiheit und echtes Entwicklungspotenzial.
Du musst noch nicht in jedem Bereich perfekt sein. Wichtig ist, dass du gestalterisch stark bist und Lust hast, mit uns zu wachsen.

Deine Ausstattung : ein neues MacBook, die volle Adobe Creative Cloud und moderne KI-Tools wie Claude, dazu professionelles Foto- und Videoequipment.
Flexibilität : Gleitzeit und mobiles Arbeiten mit zwei Tagen Homeoffice pro Woche. Die übrige Zeit bist du bei uns in der Bonner Zentrale.
Team und Entwicklung : ein motiviertes Team, gemeinsame Events sowie individuelle Weiterbildungen und Coachings, damit du dich fachlich weiterentwickelst.
Sicherheit und Vergütung : eine faire Vergütung, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Mitarbeiterbeteiligung und Bonuszahlungen.
Vorsorge und Gesundheit : eine arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge (unsere GLOBAL-FINANZ-Rente) mit Zuschüssen, eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung für bessere medizinische Versorgung und Gesundheitsangebote wie Massagen.
Mobilität : gut erreichbar mit PKW und ÖPNV, dazu JobRad.
Extras : steuerfreie Sachbezüge über die GLOBAL-FINANZ-Firmenkarte und kostenfreie Getränke in der Zentrale.
Klingt nach dir?
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und gern eine Arbeitsprobe, ein Portfolio oder einen Link zu deiner Portfolio-Seite, damit wir einen Eindruck von deinem Stil bekommen. Ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben ist willkommen, aber kein Muss.

aaf11bc0e4.t:
We're looking for a Senior Content Designer to help shape how content works across Experian's product experiences.
As the sole Content Designer in our Product Design team, you will balance hands-on content design with building the standards, systems and ways of working that help our wider team create better content.
Sitting within the Product Design team, you will work on our most strategically important customer journeys while helping establish a scalable content design practice across the organisation.

Content Design
Lead content design on priority product plans and customer journeys
Write clear, accessible and user-centred content that sets the standard for quality
Shape Tone of Voice across end-to-end experiences
Use research and insight to inform content decisions
Partner with Product Designers, Product Managers, Researchers and other important partners
Practice Building
Develop content standards, guidance and reusable patterns
Maintain and evolve a content system that enables designers to create better content independently
Coach designers through workshops, content clinics and collaboration
Champion content quality and consistency across the product experience
Improve how content design works across teams
Influence and Collaboration
Work with Legal, Compliance and Marketing to create aligned customer experiences
Advocate for customer needs and content quality in product decisions
Influence teams to ensure content design is brought earlier in the product development process
Why This Role
This isn't a role where you will review every piece of copy. Instead, you'll focus your expertise where it creates the greatest impact while building the systems and capabilities that help others make better content decisions.
You will also define how content design evolves at Experian and help raise the quality of our customer experience.
Proven experience in Content Design or UX Writing for consumer-facing digital products
Exceptional writing craft and a strong portfolio
Expertise in content design, UX writing and information architecture
Experience creating content standards, design systems or scalable frameworks
Comfortable balancing hands-on delivery with strategic practice-building work
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
Experience working in complex or regulated environments
Experience using AI and agentic workflows to support your working practice
